Canada Faces US Trade Sanctions Amid Widening Rift

The United States has imposed a ban on certain Canadian products, including spirits and vehicles, as a trade dispute between the two countries escalates. Canadian officials stated the country is in a "position of strength" to assess the damage from the trade war. Some Canadian consumers have launched a "Buy Canadian" movement, championed by Prime Minister Mark Carney, to counter the rift. The ban on Canadian spirits is expected to result in job losses, with some of these occurring in the U.S. The situation has led to discussions about Canada's identity beyond its relationship with the U.S., with some opinion pieces suggesting Canada understands issues the U.S. refuses to acknowledge.
